TextView.android:text: Automatically forward incoming notifications, SMS, RCS, and WhatsApp messages to Instant Push (ntfy.sh), Telegram bot, email inbox, or custom webhook based on your custom rules.

• Multi-Device Sync: Receive OTPs, 2FA codes, and alerts on your computer, tablet, or secondary phone without picking up this device.

• Travel & Dual-SIM: Forward critical SMS and bank alerts to your Telegram or Email while using a travel SIM.

• Team & Family Sharing: Automatically share shared account verifications, utility bills, or delivery notices with your family or team.

• Automation & Webhooks: Route important notifications straight into Discord, Slack, Zapier, or private webhook endpoints.

• 100% Private & On-Device: No cloud servers, no account required, no ads, and no tracking.

1. Choose your Forwarding Destination (Instant Push, Telegram Bot, Webhook/Discord, Email, or All).
2. Configure your destination settings (Instant Push Topic, Bot Token, Webhook URL, or SMTP).
3. (Optional) Set Keywords (e.g. 'OTP', 'Alert') or Sender Whitelist/Blacklist.
4. Select Monitored Apps (Messages & WhatsApp, or All Apps).
5. Grant Notification Access when prompted.
6. Tap 'Test Active Destination' to verify delivery.
7. Turn the switch ON at the top of the Home screen.
8. View forwarded messages in the Logs tab.
This app strictly requests only what it needs to function:

• Notification Access: Intercepts incoming notifications from messaging apps (Google Messages SMS/RCS, WhatsApp) to extract message text and sender info for forwarding. Zero sensitive SMS permissions required.

• Internet: Used exclusively to transmit forwarded messages directly to your configured Instant Push (ntfy.sh) topic, Telegram Bot, custom Webhook, or Email SMTP server.

• Foreground Service & Notifications: Keeps the background listener active and displays a status notification so you always know message monitoring is running.

Your privacy is paramount. SMS Forwarder processes all filtering rules 100% locally on your device.

• No advertising, marketing trackers, or third-party analytics SDKs are embedded.
• Message data is transmitted solely to the specific endpoints (Instant Push, Telegram, Email, Webhook) you explicitly set up.
• Forwarding history is saved strictly to your device's private sandbox and can be cleared anytime from the Logs tab.
